npcs.name: &bGuide Mae
idle: Welcome to Port Azure! Lost? Type /help any time.
The crates are east of the plaza. Left-click one to see what's inside!
Every quest pays CobbleDollars. Check your quest book often!

npcs.name: &dNurse Joy
idle: Your Pokémon are looking healthy today!
The healing machine is behind the counter. Help yourself!

npcs.name: &aClerk Ollie
idle: Fresh stock every day! Well, the same stock, but fresh.
Hold an item and type /sell to sell it.

npcs.name: &6Crate Keeper Rin
idle: Feeling lucky? Left-click a crate to see the odds.
Five keys merge into one of the next tier. For a fee, of course.

npcs.name: &3Archivist Wren
idle: The leaderboards reset at the start of each month. Mostly.
Pin your base on the map board so friends can visit!

npcs.name: &cEV Coach Tess
idle: Every stat has a training spot. Step through the gate to start!
Power items make EV training much faster.

npcs.name: &9Referee Kai
idle: Challenge a friend on the court. Fair play only!
The red box and the blue box are where trainers stand.

npcs.name: &eCaptain Marlo
idle: The sea's calm today. Good day for a ride.
Treat that Lapras well and it'll carry you anywhere.

steps.where: by the fountain in the Grand Plaza
lines: Welcome to Port Azure, {player}! I'm Mae, and I help new trainers find their feet.
The best way to learn the town is to meet everyone. Start with Nurse Joy in the Pokémon Center, the big building with the red roof, north of the plaza.
Meet everyone, then find Captain Marlo at the docks. He has a gift for you!

steps.where: inside the Pokémon Center (red roof, north of the plaza)
lines: Hello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center!
Use the healing machine whenever you like. The GTS and Wonder Trade kiosks are here too.
The rules are posted on the wall. Next, say hi to Ollie in the Poké Mart, the building with the blue roof, north-west of the plaza.

steps.where: inside the Poké Mart (blue roof, north-west of the plaza)
lines: Welcome to the Poké Mart! Type /shop to see everything we sell.
Poké Balls, healing, keys, titles and name colours. And /sell buys your extras.
Rin runs the crates across the plaza. Go take a look!

steps.where: at the Crate Pavilion (east of the plaza)
lines: Crates! Left-click one to see every reward and its exact chance.
Hold a key and right-click to open. Keys come from chores, quests, loot balls and the shop.
Wren keeps the records up north. Go see your name on the Hall of Fame!
These boards track the most Pokémon caught, the most trainers beaten and the richest trainers.
The map board is next door. Pin your base so friends can find you!
Tess trains Pokémon at the gate on the west side of town. She'll teach you about EVs.

steps.where: at the EV Training gate (west side of town)
lines: Want stronger Pokémon? EVs are the secret.
Step through this gate to reach the training grounds. Each area trains a different stat.
Kai referees battles at the Trainer Court across town. Go meet him!
This is where trainers settle things. Challenge a friend any time!
Battle fair, and shake hands after.
Last stop: Captain Marlo at the harbour. I hear he has something special for you.

steps.where: at the end of the harbour pier (south)
lines: Ahoy! So you've met the whole town, eh? Mae said you'd come.
This Lapras has been waiting for a trainer worth sailing with. She's yours.
Her riding stats are maxed out. Take her anywhere the sea goes!

reward.message: You received a Lapras with maxed riding stats, and 2,500 CobbleDollars!
